rows.text: You enter a forest that has been cultivated by words and language, tracking a Riddler who has escaped from prison. Sentences, phrases, morphemes, and phonemes wash over you and soak through your skin like raindrops, changing your body parts' original meanings.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Your outer shell transforms into aged bark and your legs begin to grow endless roots that seem to want to burrow into the soil.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You pinch at the muscle in your legs with all your strength until the pain returns everything to normal. When you get your hands on this scoundrel you're going to force-feed him every word of trash talk on the Interastral Peace Network!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I have prepared ten words for you, and I hope that you will experience the true beauty of language from them!" He slowly disappears into the forest of words, as waves of monsters made from ten words begin their assault with a great roar.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Challenge: A sentence of ten words.
